question: How does mortality rate trend across the five states from 2019 to 2022? (A) All states increase then plateau or dip slightly in 2022 (B) All states steadily decline (C) No consistent pattern. Answer with just the letter.
description: MT attack on the public_health line chart. One series is plotted on an oversized secondary y-axis (0 to 3x its max), flattening it. Misleader from Lo et al., 'Misinformed by Visualization' (EuroVis 2022): dual axis. True answer: A (A). Bait: B (B).
